stage_2_story.text_en:
On Saturday evening, David and his son Yoav decided to try the new Thai restaurant on Main Street. When they sat down, the waiter asked if they had any allergies. David mentioned that Yoav was allergic to peanuts, so the waiter made a note and promised to inform the chef.

The waiter's recommendation was the green chicken curry, but David asked whether it was spicy. The waiter said it was mild and could be made even less spicy on request. David ordered it, and Yoav chose a vegetarian noodle dish with tofu.

Both meals arrived with a small bowl of sauce on the side. David's curry was rich and flavorful without being too hot. Yoav loved his noodles and ate every last bite.

The portions were very generous. David could not finish his meal, so he asked for a box to take the leftover home. At the end, the waiter brought the receipt, and the manager also sent a compliment — two small coconut desserts as a gift for the table.

On the way home, Yoav said they should order takeout from there next weekend too. David laughed and agreed — it had been a perfect evening.
